title: channels__subscribe — input
description: Input schema for the channels__subscribe MCP tool. Registers the calling agent's interest in channels matching a pattern. Subscription persists for the agent's lifetime in the backing store. Normative reference: spec/protocol.md and spec/ports/backing-store.md §2.3.

pattern.description: Channel name pattern. Supports '*' glob wildcard (e.g. 'ticket:ENGI-*' matches 'ticket:ENGI-0001', 'ticket:ENGI-0042', etc.) and exact match (e.g. 'ticket:ENGI-0042'). Pattern matching semantics follow Unix glob rules applied to the full channel name string. Glob patterns matching reserved prefixes 'dm/' and 'group/' are rejected by the server — these namespaces require explicit channel names or group lifecycle verbs. Exact-match subscriptions to a specific 'dm/<pair>' or 'group/<id>' channel are permitted for members. See docs/decisions/dm-semantics.md and docs/decisions/groups-model.md.
